ggsegMcalt 1.0.1
  • Reference

MCALT Cortical Atlas

Source: R/data.R
mcalt_cortical.Rd

Cortical parcellation from the Mayo Clinic Adult Lifespan Template (MCALT) ADIR122 atlas.

mcalt_cortical()

Value

A ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas object (cortical).

References

Schwarz CG, et al. (2017). Alzheimer's & Dementia, 13(7):P1071. doi:10.1016/j.jalz.2017.06.1071

See also

Other ggseg_atlases: mcalt_subcortical()

Examples

mcalt_cortical()
#>

#> Regions: 78
#> Hemispheres: left, right
